title: 💸 Meera got a raise and saved nothing more... the savings rate trap #savingsrate #moneybasics
title_alts: 🧮 Meera's savings rate sets her finish line, not her salary #savingsrate #moneybasics
🧾 Meera's small monthly plan hides a huge pot... the costly mistake #savingsrate #moneybasics
description_hook: Two people save the same share of their pay, one earns triple, and both reach financial independence in the same number of years. The number that decides it is not the salary.

characters.name: Meera
characters.description: early thirties, shoulder-length black hair tied back, plain cotton kurta, a steel bangle on her right wrist

scenes.narration: Two people save the same share of their pay. One earns triple the other.
scenes.caption: दो लोग अपनी कमाई का बराबर हिस्सा बचाते हैं। एक की आमदनी तीन गुना है।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical small brass jars standing side by side on a stone windowsill, each holding the same shallow layer of coins, morning light coming in from outside.

scenes.narration: They reach financial independence in the same number of years. The income gap changes nothing.
scenes.caption: दोनों बराबर सालों में आर्थिक आज़ादी तक पहुँचते हैं। कमाई का अंतर कुछ नहीं बदलता।
scenes.image_brief: Two footpaths of different widths meeting at one painted finish line on an empty school ground, flat overcast daylight.

scenes.narration: That sounds wrong. Salary is supposed to be the whole story here.
scenes.caption: यह ग़लत लगता है। लगता है सैलरी ही सब कुछ तय करती है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed salary slip lying alone on a bare wooden table under a single overhead bulb, the total line inked darker than the rest.

scenes.narration: It is not. The pot being built does not care what anyone earns.
scenes.caption: ऐसा नहीं है। जो फंड बन रहा है, वह कमाई देखता ही नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A large clay water pot on a swept courtyard floor, its mouth open and interior dark, late afternoon sun falling across the rim.

scenes.narration: It cares what gets spent. Spending sets the target and eats the deposit.
scenes.caption: वह खर्च देखता है। खर्च लक्ष्य तय करता है और बचत भी खा जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A steel bucket on a wet cement floor with a thin stream of water escaping a crack near its base, cool daylight from a high window.

scenes.narration: Every rupee spent does damage twice. That double hit is the whole mechanism.
scenes.caption: खर्च हुआ हर रुपया दो बार नुक़सान करता है। यही पूरी मशीन है।
scenes.image_brief: A single rupee coin resting on the pan of a small kitchen weighing scale that has tipped fully to one side, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Most raises vanish. The money arrives, and the feeling of being behind stays.
scenes.caption: सैलरी बढ़ती है पर पैसा गायब हो जाता है। पीछे रहने का अहसास बना रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: An open envelope of banknotes lying on a doormat beside three unopened bills, hallway light spilling from a half-open door.

scenes.narration: A bigger salary buys a bigger flat, a longer commute, a bigger phone bill.
scenes.caption: बड़ी सैलरी बड़ा घर, लंबा सफ़र और बड़ा फ़ोन बिल ले आती है।
scenes.image_brief: A narrow city street seen from a balcony, with a larger flat's tall windows above and a long line of cars below, hazy evening light.

scenes.narration: Nothing about that is reckless. Each step looks small and sensible on its own.
scenes.caption: इसमें लापरवाही कुछ नहीं है। हर क़दम अलग से समझदारी जैसा लगता है।
scenes.image_brief: A grocery bag on a kitchen counter with four small extra items set out beside it, bright noon light through a window grille.

scenes.narration: Then the year ends. The bank balance looks exactly like last year's balance.
scenes.caption: फिर साल ख़त्म होता है। बैंक बैलेंस पिछले साल जैसा ही दिखता है।
scenes.image_brief: A wall calendar with its last page curling, every month crossed through in blue pen, dim room light from one side.

scenes.narration: People blame willpower for this. Willpower is not what is happening.
scenes.caption: लोग इसे इच्छाशक्ति की कमी कहते हैं। पर असल बात यह नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: A small clay piggy bank standing empty on a wooden shelf with a thin crack along its side, soft evening lamp light.

scenes.narration: Arithmetic is. The target moved at the same time as the income did.
scenes.caption: मामला गणित का है। आमदनी के साथ-साथ लक्ष्य भी बढ़ गया।
scenes.image_brief: A blackboard on an easel in an empty room showing two chalk columns of tally marks of equal height, daylight from tall windows.

scenes.narration: Retirement calculators ask for salary first. That question hides the important number.
scenes.caption: रिटायरमेंट कैलकुलेटर पहले सैलरी पूछते हैं। यही सवाल असली नंबर छिपा देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A pocket calculator lying face up on a glass table with a blank display, hard midday light throwing a sharp shadow.

scenes.narration: The important number is the share of take-home pay that never gets spent.
scenes.caption: असली नंबर है: हाथ में आई कमाई का वह हिस्सा जो खर्च ही नहीं होता।
scenes.image_brief: A steel tiffin box with its lid off on a table, one compartment filled with coins and the others empty, kitchen light.

scenes.narration: It has a name. Savings rate. One fraction, and it sets the clock.
scenes.caption: इसका नाम है बचत दर। एक अनुपात, और वही घड़ी तय करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A glass measuring jug on a counter filled exactly one fifth of the way with water, bright window light behind it.

scenes.narration: Someone on a modest salary can beat a high earner on that one fraction.
scenes.caption: कम सैलरी वाला भी इस एक अनुपात में ज़्यादा कमाने वाले से आगे निकल सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two unequal stacks of coins on a wooden bench, the shorter stack topped with a folded paper slip, morning light across the grain.

scenes.narration: One number can be worked out in a minute from last month's figures.
scenes.caption: पिछले महीने के आँकड़ों से यह एक नंबर मिनट भर में निकल आता है।
scenes.image_brief: A single bank statement page on a kitchen table with a pen laid across it and a glass of tea beside it, early light from a window.

scenes.narration: It converts into something concrete. Months of future freedom bought per year worked.
scenes.caption: यह ठोस चीज़ में बदल जाता है: एक साल की मेहनत से मिले आज़ादी के महीने।
scenes.image_brief: A wall calendar with three of twelve month boxes shaded in pencil, the rest blank, soft indoor daylight.

scenes.narration: A second conversion follows. Any monthly commitment turns into the lump sum behind it.
scenes.caption: दूसरा हिसाब भी है: हर मासिक खर्च के पीछे छिपी बड़ी रकम।
scenes.image_brief: A small printed subscription card standing upright beside a thick brick of banded banknotes on a desk, cool overhead light.

scenes.narration: Then the limits. The arithmetic breaks in two situations, and both matter.
scenes.caption: फिर सीमाएँ। यह गणित दो हालात में टूट जाता है, और दोनों अहम हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden ruler snapped in two pieces lying on a sheet of graph paper, hard daylight from the left.

scenes.narration: And the reframe. Why a raise is not progress until part stays unspent.
scenes.caption: और नया नज़रिया: सैलरी बढ़ना तरक़्क़ी नहीं, जब तक कुछ हिस्सा बचे नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: An unopened pay envelope propped against a locked steel cash box on a shelf, warm lamp light from one side.

scenes.narration: Start with what the pot is for. It replaces spending, not income.
scenes.caption: पहले देखें फंड किस लिए है। वह खर्च की जगह लेता है, कमाई की नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A stack of household bills weighed down by a stone on a table, a tall empty glass jar standing behind them, window light.

scenes.narration: Nobody needs to fund a salary forever. Bills are what need funding.
scenes.caption: किसी को हमेशा के लिए सैलरी नहीं चाहिए। चाहिए बिल भरने का इंतज़ाम।
scenes.image_brief: An electricity bill, a rent receipt and a grocery list laid in a row on a bedsheet, flat afternoon light from a doorway.

scenes.narration: So the size of the pot is set by one year of spending.
scenes.caption: इसलिए फंड का आकार एक साल के खर्च से तय होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A large brass vessel on a floor mat with twelve small cloth pouches arranged in a circle around it, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: A common rule of thumb multiplies that year by twenty-five. It is illustrative.
scenes.caption: एक आम मोटा नियम उस साल को पच्चीस से गुणा करता है। यह उदाहरण भर है।
scenes.image_brief: Twenty-five identical clay cups arranged in a five by five grid on a stone floor, even overcast light from above.

scenes.narration: Why twenty-five? It assumes a modest slice is drawn each year while the rest keeps working.
scenes.caption: पच्चीस क्यों? हर साल थोड़ा हिस्सा निकले और बाक़ी काम करता रहे।
scenes.image_brief: A round steamed cake on a plate with one thin slice lifted slightly away from the whole, kitchen window light.

scenes.narration: The exact multiple is argued over. The direction of the logic does not change.
scenes.caption: सही गुणक पर बहस होती रहती है। पर तर्क की दिशा नहीं बदलती।
scenes.image_brief: Two brass weights of slightly different sizes sitting on the two pans of a balance scale in a shop, dusty afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Now watch the first link. Spending appears on both sides of the arithmetic.
scenes.caption: अब पहली कड़ी देखें। खर्च गणित के दोनों तरफ़ खड़ा है।
scenes.image_brief: A folded paper boat on the surface of a full water trough with a second identical boat on the far side, bright noon light.

scenes.narration: On one side it shrinks the amount that gets saved this month. Directly.
scenes.caption: एक तरफ़ यह इस महीने की बचत को छोटा कर देता है। सीधे-सीधे।
scenes.image_brief: A thin sheaf of banknotes inside a drawer that is half open, the rest of the drawer bare wood, dim light from the room.

scenes.narration: On the other side it enlarges the pot that every future year needs.
scenes.caption: दूसरी तरफ़ यह आगे के हर साल के लिए ज़रूरी फंड को बड़ा कर देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A tall earthen storage jar towering over a small one on a barn floor, straw scattered around, light from an open door.

scenes.narration: That is the double hit. One habit, two wounds, pointing in opposite directions.
scenes.caption: यही दोहरी चोट है। एक आदत, दो घाव, दोनों उलटी दिशा में।
scenes.image_brief: A frayed rope lying on a dusty floor pulled taut between two iron hooks, both ends unravelling, light from a high window.

scenes.narration: Take a recurring cost of one thousand a month. Twelve thousand a year.
scenes.caption: मान लें हर महीने एक हज़ार का पक्का खर्च। साल में बारह हज़ार।
scenes.image_brief: Twelve identical coins laid in a straight line along the edge of a kitchen shelf, evening light coming through the doorway.

scenes.narration: Twenty-five times twelve thousand is three lakh. That is the pot it demands.
scenes.caption: बारह हज़ार का पच्चीस गुना है तीन लाख। इतना फंड यह खर्च माँगता है।
scenes.image_brief: A single thick bundle of banded banknotes standing upright on a bare table beside one loose coin, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: So a thousand a month is a three lakh commitment. Permanently.
scenes.caption: तो हर महीने का एक हज़ार तीन लाख का वादा है। हमेशा के लिए।
scenes.image_brief: A brass padlock clamped through the handle of a heavy wooden chest in a storeroom, thin light from a ventilator above.

scenes.narration: Shorten that. Any monthly amount times three hundred gives the pot behind it.
scenes.caption: छोटा तरीक़ा: किसी भी मासिक रकम को तीन सौ से गुणा करें।
scenes.image_brief: A long paper till roll unspooled across a shop floor, curling at the far end, fluorescent light overhead.

scenes.narration: Three hundred, because twenty-five years of twelve months is three hundred months.
scenes.caption: तीन सौ, क्योंकि पच्चीस साल के बारह महीने तीन सौ महीने होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A wall of small square post-office letter boxes filling the frame, rows of identical numbered doors, flat indoor light.

scenes.narration: Now the second link. What builds the pot is the gap, not the pay.
scenes.caption: अब दूसरी कड़ी। फंड सैलरी से नहीं, कमाई और खर्च के अंतर से बनता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two boulders in a shallow stream with water running fast through the narrow gap between them, bright sun overhead.

scenes.narration: Income minus spending. That gap is the only money that ever arrives inside.
scenes.caption: कमाई घटाओ खर्च। यही अंतर वह पैसा है जो फंड तक पहुँचता है।
scenes.image_brief: A tap running into a wide steel basin while an open drain beside it carries most of the water away, cool morning light.

scenes.narration: Compounding then works on whatever sits inside. It cannot work on money already spent.
scenes.caption: चक्रवृद्धि उसी पर काम करती है जो अंदर है। खर्च हुए पैसे पर नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A ball of dough rolled along a floured kitchen slab, visibly larger at the far end of its path, window light.

scenes.narration: Here is why income cancels out. Double the pay and double the spending.
scenes.caption: कमाई का असर यहाँ कटता है। सैलरी दोगुनी, खर्च भी दोगुना।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical market stalls facing each other across a lane, one piled twice as high with produce, midday sun.

scenes.narration: The gap doubles, so deposits double. The target doubles too, at the same moment.
scenes.caption: अंतर दोगुना, जमा दोगुनी। लक्ष्य भी उसी समय दोगुना हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two glass jars on a shelf, one twice the height of the other, each filled to exactly the same marked level, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: A doubled deposit against a doubled target is the same journey. Ratio unchanged.
scenes.caption: दोगुनी जमा और दोगुना लक्ष्य मिलकर वही सफ़र बनाते हैं। अनुपात वही रहा।
scenes.image_brief: Two staircases of different widths inside a stairwell, both ending at the same landing door, light from a skylight.

scenes.narration: Which leaves the fraction. Savings rate, and nothing about the size of the salary.
scenes.caption: बचता है सिर्फ़ अनुपात। बचत दर, और सैलरी के आकार से कोई मतलब नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A single wooden block resting on the upper half of a chalk line drawn across a courtyard floor, long evening shadows.

scenes.narration: Two earners far apart, one shared fraction, one finish line. Now the numbers.
scenes.caption: कमाई में दूर-दूर दो लोग, एक जैसा अनुपात, एक ही मंज़िल। अब आँकड़े।
scenes.image_brief: Two running lanes on a dusty track converging at one taut finish tape, early morning light and long shadows.

scenes.narration: Round figures ahead, chosen to be easy. They are illustrative, not a forecast.
scenes.caption: आगे के आँकड़े गोल और आसान हैं। ये सिर्फ़ उदाहरण हैं, भविष्यवाणी नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A clean notebook page open on a desk with a sharpened pencil and a steel ruler beside it, bright even daylight.

scenes.narration: Meera takes home fifty thousand rupees a month. Her spending runs forty thousand.
scenes.caption: मीरा के हाथ में हर महीने 50,000 रुपये आते हैं। खर्च 40,000 का है।
scenes.image_brief: Meera, a woman in her thirties with shoulder-length black hair tied back, wearing a plain cotton kurta and a steel bangle on her right wrist, seated at a small dining table with a bank statement and a cup of tea, morning light from the window.

scenes.narration: Ten thousand is left over. Savings rate: twenty percent of take-home pay.
scenes.caption: 10,000 बच जाते हैं। बचत दर: हाथ में आई कमाई का 20 प्रतिशत।
scenes.image_brief: Two paper envelopes on a dining table, one thick and one thin, a pencil lying between them, morning light from a window.

scenes.narration: Her spending year is four lakh eighty thousand. Forty thousand, taken twelve times.
scenes.caption: उसका सालाना खर्च 4,80,000 है। चालीस हज़ार, बारह बार।
scenes.image_brief: A twelve-month desk calendar standing open on a shelf, every month tabbed with a small paper flag, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Twenty-five times that is one crore twenty lakh. That is her target pot.
scenes.caption: उसका पच्चीस गुना है 1.2 करोड़। यही उसका लक्ष्य फंड है।
scenes.image_brief: A tall empty glass cylinder on a kitchen counter with a thin strip of tape marking a line near the rim, bright noon light.

scenes.narration: Ten thousand a month is one lakh twenty thousand saved in a year.
scenes.caption: हर महीने 10,000 का मतलब साल में 1,20,000 की बचत।
scenes.image_brief: A cloth pouch of coins on a table beside twelve small paper packets arranged in a row, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Against a target that size, that looks hopeless. It is not. Here is why.
scenes.caption: इतने बड़े लक्ष्य के सामने यह नाउम्मीद लगता है। पर है नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A steep flight of stone steps climbing a hillside, the top lost in mist, early grey light.

scenes.narration: Convert it instead. Each year of work funds how many months of future spending?
scenes.caption: इसे बदलकर देखें। एक साल की कमाई आगे के कितने महीने चलाएगी?
scenes.image_brief: A metal kitchen scale with a small heap of rice on one pan and a much larger heap in a bowl beside it, window light.

scenes.narration: She saves ten thousand and spends forty thousand. That ratio is one to four.
scenes.caption: वह 10,000 बचाती है और 40,000 खर्च करती है। अनुपात एक और चार का।
scenes.image_brief: Four identical steel tumblers on a tray, one filled with water and three empty, afternoon light falling across the tray.

scenes.narration: So one year of work funds three months of her future life.
scenes.caption: यानी एक साल की मेहनत आगे के तीन महीने चलाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A twelve-slot pill organiser open on a shelf with only the first three slots filled with small coins, cool overhead light.

scenes.narration: Four years of work for one year of freedom. That is the exchange rate.
scenes.caption: चार साल की मेहनत, एक साल की आज़ादी। यही विनिमय दर है।
scenes.image_brief: Four bricks stacked in a low pile beside a single finished brick step on a dusty construction site, afternoon sun.

scenes.narration: Now the raise. Take-home moves up to sixty-five thousand a month.
scenes.caption: अब सैलरी बढ़ती है। हाथ में आने वाली रकम 65,000 हो जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Meera's hands with a steel bangle on the right wrist holding an opened pay envelope, noticeably thicker than before, over the same dining table, morning light.

scenes.narration: Version one. Spending climbs to fifty-two thousand, so saving becomes thirteen thousand.
scenes.caption: पहला रास्ता: खर्च 52,000 हो जाता है, बचत 13,000 रह जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A household shopping basket on a kitchen floor piled higher than usual with vegetables and packets, light from a doorway.

scenes.narration: Thirteen out of sixty-five is twenty percent. The fraction never moved.
scenes.caption: 65,000 में से 13,000 यानी 20 प्रतिशत। अनुपात वहीं का वहीं रहा।
scenes.image_brief: Two glass tumblers of different sizes on a counter, tea filled to exactly the same fraction of each, warm light.

scenes.narration: Her spending year is now six lakh twenty-four thousand. The target follows it upward.
scenes.caption: अब सालाना खर्च 6,24,000 है। लक्ष्य भी उसी के साथ ऊपर चढ़ जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A ledger book lying open flat on a table with one column of handwritten figures noticeably longer than the column beside it, lamp light.

scenes.narration: Twenty-five times that is one crore fifty-six lakh. Thirty-six lakh added.
scenes.caption: उसका पच्चीस गुना है 1.56 करोड़। छत्तीस लाख और जुड़ गए।
scenes.image_brief: A tall stack of banded note bundles on a steel trunk with three extra bundles set on top, dim storeroom light.

scenes.narration: A raise arrived, and the finish line walked away by exactly the same logic.
scenes.caption: सैलरी बढ़ी, और उसी हिसाब से मंज़िल भी आगे खिसक गई।
scenes.image_brief: A finish tape on a running track being carried further down the lane by the wind, empty stadium seats behind it, bright morning light.

scenes.narration: Version two. Spending stays at forty thousand, so saving jumps to twenty-five thousand.
scenes.caption: दूसरा रास्ता: खर्च 40,000 पर टिका रहता है, बचत 25,000 हो जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: The same household shopping basket on the kitchen floor filled only to its usual level, a few unbought packets left on the shelf above, light from a doorway.

scenes.narration: That is thirty-eight percent of take-home. The target stays at one crore twenty lakh.
scenes.caption: यह कमाई का 38 प्रतिशत है। लक्ष्य 1.2 करोड़ पर ही टिका रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: A glass jar on a counter filled well past the tape mark near its middle, the tape itself unmoved, bright noon light.

scenes.narration: Twenty-five saved against forty spent is five-eighths of a year, per year worked.
scenes.caption: 40,000 खर्च के मुक़ाबले 25,000 बचत, यानी हर साल का पाँच-बटा-आठ साल।
scenes.image_brief: A round flatbread on a plate cut into eight wedges with five wedges pushed to one side, kitchen window light.

scenes.narration: Seven and a half months bought per year, up from three. Same raise.
scenes.caption: अब हर साल साढ़े सात महीने मिलते हैं, तीन के बजाय। वही सैलरी बढ़ोतरी।
scenes.image_brief: A row of twelve small glass bottles on a windowsill, seven full of water and the eighth half full, afternoon light behind them.

scenes.narration: This arithmetic is deliberately blind to growth. Real pots grow while they sit.
scenes.caption: यह गणित जान-बूझकर बढ़त को छोड़ देता है। असली फंड रखे-रखे बढ़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: A sapling in a clay pot standing beside a full-grown tree in a courtyard, both rooted in the same soil, soft morning light.

scenes.narration: Growth shortens the wait, sometimes sharply. The ratio is the starting point, not the answer.
scenes.caption: बढ़त इंतज़ार घटाती है, कभी बहुत। अनुपात शुरुआत है, पूरा जवाब नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A steep hill road with a narrow footpath cutting straight across its bends, dry grass on both sides, early sun.

scenes.narration: It also assumes later spending resembles spending now. Often it does not.
scenes.caption: यह भी मानता है कि आगे का खर्च आज जैसा रहेगा। अक्सर नहीं रहता।
scenes.image_brief: A hospital corridor bench with a folded shawl and a steel water bottle resting on it, cool fluorescent light overhead.

scenes.narration: Health costs, family duties, a shifted city: each one moves the target.
scenes.caption: इलाज का खर्च, परिवार की ज़िम्मेदारी, शहर बदलना: हर बात लक्ष्य बदल देती है।
scenes.image_brief: A packed suitcase and two taped cardboard boxes standing by a flat's open door, an empty name plate on the frame, hallway light.

scenes.narration: The multiple itself is a rough illustration. Nobody is owed a fixed withdrawal.
scenes.caption: वह गुणक भी बस एक मोटा उदाहरण है। तय निकासी किसी का हक़ नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: A painted measuring stick nailed to the inner wall of a stone well, its lower marks worn away, dim light down the shaft.

scenes.narration: Now the harder limit. The fraction means little near the cost of survival.
scenes.caption: अब बड़ी सीमा। गुज़ारे की हद के पास यह अनुपात मायने नहीं रखता।
scenes.image_brief: A bare kitchen shelf holding one steel tin of flour and a single onion, harsh afternoon light through a small window.

scenes.narration: If rent and food take almost everything, the lever is not the rate.
scenes.caption: जब किराया और खाना ही सब ले जाएँ, तो बचत दर कोई चाबी नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: A rent receipt and a vegetable bill weighed down by a stone on a doorstep, an open empty wallet beside them, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: It is income, or the cost of the basics. Arithmetic cannot conjure a gap.
scenes.caption: चाबी है कमाई, या ज़रूरी चीज़ों की क़ीमत। गणित अंतर पैदा नहीं कर सकता।
scenes.image_brief: A dry hand pump in a village square with an empty bucket beneath its spout, midday sun directly overhead.

scenes.narration: A high savings rate is a privilege before it is a discipline.
scenes.caption: ऊँची बचत दर अनुशासन से पहले एक सहूलियत है।
scenes.image_brief: Two tenement roofs across a narrow lane, one carrying a full water tank and the other only an empty steel frame, hazy evening light.

scenes.narration: The common mistake is a different one, and it catches comfortable earners.
scenes.caption: आम ग़लती कुछ और है, और वह अच्छी कमाई वालों को पकड़ती है।
scenes.image_brief: A tidy living room with one unopened appliance carton in the corner and a small stack of plain membership cards on the table, lamp light.

scenes.narration: One-off spending and recurring spending get treated as the same kind of thing.
scenes.caption: एक बार का खर्च और हर महीने का खर्च एक ही तराज़ू पर तोल दिए जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two shopping bills pinned side by side on a kitchen corkboard, one very long and one short, evening lamp light.

scenes.narration: A single large purchase dents the deposit once. It leaves the target alone.
scenes.caption: एक बड़ी ख़रीद बचत को एक बार चोट देती है। लक्ष्य को छूती नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A new steel almirah standing against a bedroom wall with its packing foam still lying on the floor, daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: A small monthly commitment raises the target forever. Three hundred times, every month.
scenes.caption: हर महीने का छोटा खर्च लक्ष्य हमेशा के लिए बढ़ा देता है। तीन सौ गुना।
scenes.image_brief: A small monthly payment slip lying on a table beside a very tall column of stacked coins, warm light from one side.

scenes.narration: Back to the two people from the start. Incomes far apart, one shared fraction.
scenes.caption: शुरू के उन दो लोगों पर लौटें। कमाई अलग-अलग, अनुपात एक जैसा।
scenes.image_brief: The two identical brass jars back on the stone windowsill, now filled with coins to the same height, late afternoon light.

scenes.narration: The high earner funds a larger life. Larger life, larger pot required.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादा कमाने वाला बड़ी ज़िंदगी चलाता है। बड़ी ज़िंदगी, बड़ा फंड।
scenes.image_brief: A long dining table set for eight in a spacious room with every chair pulled out, evening light through tall windows.

scenes.narration: The modest earner funds a smaller one, and needs less of it.
scenes.caption: कम कमाने वाला छोटी ज़िंदगी चलाता है, और उसे कम की ज़रूरत है।
scenes.image_brief: A small floor mat laid for two with two steel plates and one shared bowl, warm light from a single bulb.

scenes.narration: Both are running at the same ratio. So both arrive in the same span.
scenes.caption: दोनों एक ही अनुपात पर चल रहे हैं। इसलिए दोनों एक ही समय में पहुँचते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two bicycle tyre tracks running side by side along a dirt road, both the same length, early morning light.

scenes.narration: Salary decides how comfortable the journey is. The gap decides how long it lasts.
scenes.caption: सैलरी तय करती है सफ़र कितना आरामदेह है। अंतर तय करता है वह कितना लंबा है।
scenes.image_brief: A long railway platform with a cushioned bench and a plain wooden bench facing the same track, both empty, grey morning light.

scenes.narration: That is the reframe. Earning more is not the same as getting closer.
scenes.caption: यही नया नज़रिया है। ज़्यादा कमाना और मंज़िल के पास पहुँचना एक बात नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A stone milestone half buried in grass at the edge of a highway, its far face turned away, harsh noon sun.

scenes.narration: A raise is neutral by itself. What happens next sets its direction.
scenes.caption: सैलरी बढ़ना अपने आप में तटस्थ है। दिशा अगला क़दम तय करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A coin standing balanced upright on its edge on a bare wooden table, nothing else in frame, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Spent completely, it resets the clock. Partly unspent, it pulls the finish line closer.
scenes.caption: पूरा खर्च हो गया तो घड़ी रीसेट। कुछ बच गया तो मंज़िल पास आ जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A wind-up alarm clock on a bedside table with its winding key turned back to the start, dim early light.

scenes.narration: Chasing returns gets the attention. The gap is the part actually under control.
scenes.caption: रिटर्न के पीछे भागना सबका ध्यान खींचता है। अपने बस में तो अंतर है।
scenes.image_brief: A blank market ticker board of empty rows on a wall above a deserted counter, cool indoor light.

scenes.narration: One fraction, two effects, and a target that only spending gets to set.
scenes.caption: एक अनुपात, दो असर, और लक्ष्य सिर्फ़ खर्च तय करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A single tap above a brimming steel drum with one drop hanging from the spout, soft window light.

scenes.narration: The one calculation: last month's take-home, minus what left the account, divided by take-home.
scenes.caption: एक हिसाब: पिछले महीने की कमाई, घटाओ जो निकला, भाग दो कमाई से।
scenes.image_brief: A bank statement page on a table with a pen resting on its final line and a plain calculator beside it, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Then one monthly subscription, times three hundred. That number is the pot behind it.
scenes.caption: फिर किसी एक मासिक ख़र्चे को तीन सौ से गुणा करें। वही उसका असली दाम है।
scenes.image_brief: A folded paper payment mandate on a desk under a glass paperweight with a tall stack of coins behind it, evening light.
